<FILENAME>ea030988701ex10-2.htm
<DESCRIPTION>IONETIX RADIOISOTOPES, INC. ANNUAL PERFORMANCE BONUS PLAN
<TEXT>
<HTML>
<HEAD>
     <TITLE></TITLE>
</HEAD>
<BODY STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif">

<P STYLE="text-align: right; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><B>Exhibit 10.2</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: bold 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-transform: uppercase; text-align: center">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: bold 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; text-transform: uppercase; text-align: center">IONETIX RADIOISOTOPES,
INC.</P>

<P STYLE="font: bold 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; text-transform: uppercase; text-align: center">ANNUAL PERFORMANCE
BONUS PLAN</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in">IONETIX RADIOISOTOPES, INC.,
a Delaware corporation (the &ldquo;<B>Company</B>&rdquo;), adopts this discretionary annual performance bonus plan (this &ldquo;<B>Plan</B>&rdquo;)
to guide the approval and payment of discretionary annual performance cash bonuses (each a &ldquo;<B>Bonus</B>&rdquo;) to eligible Company
employees (each a &ldquo;<B>Participant</B>&rdquo;).</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in">This Plan is effective for
the 2026 calendar year and each subsequent calendar year until it is amended or terminated (each a &ldquo;<B>Bonus Year</B>&rdquo;).</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in">1.&nbsp;<B>Administration</B>.
The compensation committee (the &ldquo;<B>Committee</B>&rdquo;) of the Board of Directors of Ionetix Corporation (the &ldquo;<B>Board</B>&rdquo;)
will oversee the administration of this Plan, with the authority of the Board. The Committee is responsible for approving the matters
reserved to it in this Plan and for overseeing the implementation of the Plan by the Company&rsquo;s Chief Executive Officer (&ldquo;<B>CEO</B>&rdquo;).
The CEO will implement the Plan in accordance with its terms and the Committee&rsquo;s authority, and will report to the Committee on
the administration of the Plan as requested. The Committee&rsquo;s and CEO&rsquo;s respective approvals, interpretations, determinations,
resolutions of disputes, and other actions taken in accordance with this Plan are binding and conclusive on Participants. The Committee
and CEO may delegate their respective authority or discretion under this Plan, and references to each of them includes their authorized
delegates.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in">2.&nbsp;<B>Eligibility</B>.
The Company&rsquo;s full-time employees will be eligible to participate in this Plan, except for the CEO, the Chief Financial Officer,
interns, and any other employee whom the Committee or CEO determines are ineligible. Part-time employees are ineligible except as determined
by the CEO.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">Each Participant may be eligible to earn a target
Bonus amount equal to a percentage of their Base Salary based on performance factors.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in">3.&nbsp;<B>Target
Bonus and Performance Framework</B>. The Committee will determine and approve target Bonus percentages of Base Salary by employee category,
and that approval will remain in effect for each Bonus Year until changed by the Committee. &ldquo;<B>Base Salary</B>&rdquo; means a Participant&rsquo;s
annual base salary in effect on the last day of the applicable Bonus Year. The CEO may prorate or adjust a Bonus for a Participant who
begins employment, changes position, changes Base Salary, takes an approved leave, or experiences other relevant circumstances during
a Bonus Year.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">Participants will earn Bonuses based primarily
on the Company&rsquo;s achievement of the annual corporate goals and objectives set by the Board and individual performance.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in">4.&nbsp;<B>Bonus
Determination and Performance Range</B>. The CEO will have discretion to determine each Participant&rsquo;s Bonus for a Bonus Year, based
on achievement of the Company&rsquo;s annual corporate goals and objectives and other relevant performance factors, subject to the following:</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.5in; text-align: justify; text-indent: -0.25in">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="width: 100%; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.5in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.25in">a)</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify"><B>Minimum Performance (Threshold)</B>. In general, no Bonuses will be earned for a Bonus Year unless
the Committee determines that the Company has achieved at least 80% of its overall corporate goals and objectives for that Bonus Year
(the &ldquo;<B>Threshold</B>&rdquo;).</TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.5in; text-align: justify">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.5in; text-align: justify">The Committee may, in its discretion,
approve Bonuses in circumstances when the Company does not achieve the 80% Threshold.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.5in; text-align: justify; text-indent: -0.25in">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.5in; text-align: justify; text-indent: -0.25in"></P>

<!-- Field: Page; Sequence: 1 -->
    <DIV STYLE="margin-top: 12pt; margin-bottom: 6pt; border-bottom: Black 1.5pt solid"><P STYLE="margin: 0pt"></P></DIV>
    <DIV STYLE="break-before: page; margin-top: 6pt; margin-bottom: 12pt"><P STYLE="margin: 0pt"></P></DIV>
    <!-- Field: /Page -->

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.5in; text-align: justify; text-indent: -0.25in">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; width: 100%"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top; text-align: justify">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.5in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.25in; text-align: left">b)</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify"><B>Maximum Bonus (Cap)</B>. A Participant&rsquo;s Bonus may
be up to 120% of the Participant&rsquo;s target Bonus amount (the &ldquo;Cap&rdquo;). Any Bonus above 120% of the Participant&rsquo;s
target Bonus requires Committee approval.</TD>
</TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">The CEO&rsquo;s determination of each Participant&rsquo;s
performance and Bonus for a Bonus Year is discretionary and final, subject to the Threshold, the Cap, and the Committee&rsquo;s oversight
and authority.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">All Bonuses are discretionary and are not earned
or payable until approved and paid to the Participant.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in">5.&nbsp;<B>Termination
of Employment</B>. A Participant must remain employed with the Company through the entire Bonus Year and through the Bonus payment date
to be eligible to be paid a Bonus. The Company will not pay a Bonus to a Participant who is not employed by the Company on the payment
date, regardless of the reason for the Participant&rsquo;s termination of employment. The CEO may approve an exception to this requirement
in circumstances that the CEO determines to be appropriate, subject to the oversight and authority of the Committee.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in">6.&nbsp;<B>Payment</B>.
The CEO will cause the Company to pay approved Bonuses to eligible Participants during the period that begins on January 1<SUP>st</SUP>
and ends on March 15<SUP>th</SUP>, following the applicable Bonus Year. Approved Bonuses are gross amounts and are subject to taxes and
other required withholdings.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in">7.&nbsp;<B>Repayment</B>.
A Participant must repay any Bonus amount that the Committee or CEO determines was paid the Participant in error. A Participant must also
repay a Bonus amount to the extent required under any applicable clawback or similar provision.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in">8.&nbsp;<B>Amendment
and Termination.</B> The Committee may recommend amendments to, or termination of, this Plan to the Board. The Board may amend or terminate
this Plan at any time by written consent or resolution. Any amendment or termination of this Plan will be effective as of the date specified
by the Board and will apply to all unpaid Bonuses, including Bonuses for the Bonus Year in which the amendment or termination occurs,
unless the Board determines otherwise. This Plan may only be amended in writing, and any alleged oral amendment or change shall have no
effect.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in">9.&nbsp;<B>Unfunded
Plan.</B> This Plan and Bonuses are unfunded. The Company has no obligation to segregate, reserve, or pool assets to secure or provide
for the payment of Bonuses. A Participant has no interest in any specific assets of the Company with respect to a Bonus.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in">10.&nbsp;<B>Compliance</B>.
This Plan is governed by Delaware law, excluding conflicts of law principles. This Plan is intended to be exempt from ERISA as a bonus
program and payroll practice. This Plan is intended to be exempt from Section 409A of the Internal Revenue Code under the so-called &ldquo;short-term
deferral&rdquo; exemption. This Plan, each Bonus, and all rights and obligations arising under this Plan are subject to applicable law
and the rules and regulations of the Securities and Exchange Commission and The Nasdaq Stock Market LLC, including Exchange Act Rule 10D-1,
Nasdaq Rule 5608, and any similar compensation recovery requirement, in each case to the extent applicable. This Plan must be interpreted
and administered accordingly.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"></P>
